ModMetaData.name: Casualties: Rimknown
ModMetaData.author: Creeperslayers6
ModMetaData.description:
Casualties: Rimknown implements Factions and Content based off the Crossover AU between RimWorld and Casualties: Unknown.
Features: - Experiment-based Civil and Rough Outlander Factions and Neutral Empire-based Faction. - Casualties: Rimknown-based Starting Scenario (w.i.p) - Braingrow, Mindwipe, and Neural Booster. - New Sound Cannon Security Turret. - Two new Extreme Mental Breaks - New Backstories for Experiment Xenotype - Last Stand Gene/Ability - Patches for Erin's Experiments
Requires: - RimWorld - Biotech DLC - Harmony Mod - Vanilla Expanded Framework
Supported Xenotype Mods (Requires One): - Erin's Experiments - Erin's Experiments, Milky and Dune Patch - Gexies expies - Gexies milkies
Incompatible with: - Casualties: Rimknown - Sound Cannon
Casualties: Unknown Game/IP is Created/Owned by Orsoniks.
